slug: 2026-01-29 Djibouti develops national AI strategy with UN support

facts.fact: TechAfrica News reports Djibouti is developing its first National AI Strategy, led by the education, innovation and digital ministry (MENIDjib) with UNESCO and UN-ESCWA support, beginning with a UNESCO readiness-assessment diagnostic; the document gives no event date, so the published date 2026-01-29 is used.
